Gold Appraisal Leads Atlanta

If you're a jeweler, estate buyer or appraiser in Atlanta, CaratBase sends you leads from people looking to sell gold or request an appraisal. The first 3 leads are free, then $40 per accepted lead.

How It Works

  • Accept or decline – Choose the leads that fit your business.
  • No upfront cost – The first 3 leads are free.
  • $40 per accepted lead after that.

Optional website widget

Optionally, a Pro website widget is $12/month (cancel whenever; it drops back to the free version). The free widgets are available at no cost on the widgets page.

FAQ

Does CaratBase provide gold appraisal leads in Atlanta? CaratBase is starting in Atlanta and sends leads to jewelers, estate buyers, and appraisers.

How much does it cost? The first 3 leads are free. After that, each accepted lead costs $40. A Pro website widget is optional at $12/month.
